topic: District Council unemployment rate (區議會分區失業率)
reason: GHS sample too small; data.gov.hk has no UR by District Council. Closest: LF/LFPR by district (210-06821).

topic: 區議會分區失業率（搜尋確認）
reason: Confirmed unavailable: district-level UR not published; only LF and LFPR by district. Do not equate LFPR with UR.

topic: District-level violent crime / crime by District Council
reason: HKPF does not publish District Council district-level violent crime on data.gov.hk; territory-wide CSVs only.

topic: Exact primary school places / 5-year-old demand by district
reason: Exact places allocation and age-5 demand by district not published; use enrolment-by-district + population proxies and state the gap.

topic: List of school closures / mergers (殺校名單)
reason: No published closure/merger list. Proxy: diff SchoolBasicInfo.xml SchoolNumber sets via historical-archive; net sector counts mask offsetting openings. Verify against EDB/LegCo.

topic: Police smart CCTV / public-place CCTV deployment counts
reason: Not open data; security/ops figures appear only in LegCo papers / press. Proxies (not equivalent): TD red-light/speed cameras; FEHD illegal-dumping IP cameras; SCIOCS intercept warrants.

topic: Named scam organisation / overseas scam park / syndicate X (HK links & figures)
reason: No data.gov.hk dataset for named compounds or trafficking-to-X breakdowns. Use Security Bureau / LegCo / HKPF press for cumulative assistance figures; place timelines need independent reporting. Always state moving baselines.

topic: Government application procedures / how-to guides (e.g. BR registration steps)
reason: data.gov.hk has machine-readable stats/fees, not procedural guides. Point to department / GovHK pages; may cite fee or new-registration series as supplements.

topic: Northern Metropolis investment scale / ROI / mega-infra total as one open-data figure
reason: No aggregated NM investment/ROI time series. Closest: DEVB NMCO GIS boundaries; Treasury CWRF capital works; Budget/Action Agenda narrative figures.

topic: FDI round-tripping share / UBO Western-FDI split
reason: Official DI by immediate counterpart exists (315-38011); no published round-tripping % or UBO Western-FDI series.

topic: Wall Street / US bank headcount cuts in HK; global IPO fundraising ranking
reason: No employer headcount-by-Wall-Street or global IPO rank dataset. Related but different: RHQ counts (325-43011A), HKEX funds raised (340-95003).

topic: Causal link: imported labour cutting local wages / disposable income
reason: SLS counts and wage indices exist separately; no official series attributing wage/income changes to labour importation.

topic: HKPL advanced catalogue / holdings API (beyond RSS syndication)
reason: No REST/OAI-PMH/SRU/Z39.50/OpenSearch/GraphQL catalogue API on data.gov.hk. Proxy: webcat RSS syndication (~5 items) + HTML item holdings scrape; ebook/top100/BRO CSVs are not live holdings.

topic: 寵物友善／狗狗餐廳名單 (pet-friendly restaurants)
reason: FEHD licence INFO_CODE has no pet flag; OSA outdoor seating ≠ pet-friendly. Closest open data: LCSD dog parks / pet-sharing parks. Commercial lists are out of scope.

topic: LCSD SmartPLAY table tennis (乒乓球) real-time court session availability
reason: SmartPLAY open-data catalog (GET https://data.smartplay.lcsd.gov.hk/rest/cms/api/v1/publ/contents/open-data) lists only activity-prog, turf-soccer-pitch, tennis, badminton, basketball, volleyball. .../open-data/table-tennis/file returns HTTP 404. data.gov.hk has location datasets (hk-lcsd-csdi-table-tennis-tables, hk-lcsd-facility-facility-ottt) and activity-prog classes, but no Available Session feed for table tennis. Proxies: outdoor tables (facility-ottt); book via SmartPLAY UI; analogous session feeds for badminton/tennis/basketball/volleyball/turf.
